series.name: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)
series.notes: The 9PX family does NOT use numeric A/F codes in the manual; it uses named LCD conditions with LED + beeper patterns, and separate Event log / Fault log lists on the front panel. Second source: Eaton 9PX Gen2 5-11 kVA Advanced user manual (https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/backup-power-ups-surge-it-power-distribution/backup-power-ups/eaton-9px-gen2-emea/9px-gen2-resources-emea/eaton-9px-5-11-kva-gen2-advanced-user-manual-en-us.pdf) reproduces the same 11 conditions; the only difference found is UPS overtemperature, which the Gen2 manual gives as 'Beep continuous' instead of '1 beep every 3 seconds'. Do NOT reuse 9E A/F codes for a 9PX.

title.ur: Battery mode (UPS battery par chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Utility power has failed and the UPS is supplying the load from its batteries. This is a status, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Utility power chala gaya hai aur UPS load ko apni batteries se de raha hai. Ye status hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed or is out of the transfer window.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai ya transfer range se bahar hai.

causes.en: The user has deliberately switched the UPS to battery mode to run on battery.
causes.ur: User ne jaanbujhkar UPS ko battery mode par switch kiya hai taake battery par chale.

solutions.en: Save your work and prepare connected equipment for shutdown, because runtime is finite.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur connected equipment ko shutdown ke liye tayyar karein, kyunke runtime mehdud hai.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level from the LCD so you know how long you have.
solutions.ur: LCD se baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein taake pata chale kitna waqt bacha hai.

solutions.en: When mains returns, confirm the UPS has gone back to Normal mode and the battery is charging (charging indicator on).
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke UPS Normal mode wapas aa gaya hai aur battery charge ho rahi hai (charging indicator on).

codes.blinkPattern: Battery-mode LED solid On, 1 beep every 10 seconds

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

title.ur: Battery low (runtime khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery and the battery has reached its low-charge warning level. Runtime left is short.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai aur battery low-charge warning level par aa chuki hai. Baqi runtime bohat kam hai.

causes.en: The outage has lasted long enough to drain the batteries down to the warning level.
causes.ur: Outage itni der rahi ke batteries warning level tak drain ho gayin.

causes.en: The battery string is aged and holds less charge than rated.
causes.ur: Battery string purani hai aur rated se kam charge rakhti hai.

solutions.en: Shut down non-essential equipment now to extend the remaining runtime.
solutions.ur: Baaqi runtime barhane ke liye abhi ghair zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the actual remaining runtime on the LCD; the manual warns the estimate varies a lot with load and EBM count.
solutions.ur: LCD par asal baaqi runtime parhein; manual kehti hai ke estimate load aur EBM ki tadaad ke saath bohat badalti hai.

solutions.en: Do not start large loads now; if mains returns, let the UPS charge on utility for 48 hours.
solutions.ur: Ab bade loads start na karein; mains wapas aaye to UPS ko 48 ghante utility par charge karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Battery-low LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

meaning.en: The UPS has lost the battery string; if mains fails now the load gets no backup. Continuous beep means this is logged as a fault.
meaning.ur: UPS ki battery string kho gayi hai; ab mains chala to load ko koi backup nahi milega. Continuous beep ka matlab hai ke ye fault ke taur par log hota hai.

causes.en: The internal battery connector is unplugged or the connector is not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nahi laga hua ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: The external battery module (EBM) power connector or its detection connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: External battery module (EBM) ka power connector ya us ka detection connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery harness or connector pin is loose, corroded, bent or broken.
causes.ur: Battery harness ya connector ka pin dhile, zang khaa, muda ya toota hua hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass (or shut down safely), switch the UPS off, unplug the mains, then use insulated gloves and tools.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein (ya mehfoof se band karein), UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, phir insulated gloves aur tools use karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; reseat the EBM power and detection connectors firmly.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se lagi hain; EBM power aur detection connectors ko mazbooti se dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: Measure the DC voltage across the battery terminals with a DMM; no reading means the string is open or dead.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery terminals par DC voltage maarein; koi reading nahi ka matlab hai ke string khuli ya marri hui hai.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

meaning.en: The battery test failed because of bad or disconnected batteries, or the minimum battery voltage was reached during ABM cycling.
meaning.ur: Battery test fail ho gaya kyunke batteries kharab ya disconnect hain, ya ABM cycling mein battery ka minimum voltage aa gaya.

causes.en: One or more battery cells are dead, shorted, or the string is at end of life.
causes.ur: Battery ke koi aik ya zyada cells mar chuke hain, short hain, ya string end of life par hai.

causes.en: A battery connector is disconnected, so the test sees an abnormal string.
causes.ur: Battery connector disconnect hai, is liye test ko string ajeeb nazar aati hai.

causes.en: In ABM (Advanced Battery Management) cycling the battery reached its minimum voltage.
causes.ur: ABM (Advanced Battery Management) cycling mein battery ka minimum voltage aa gaya.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected with the UPS switched off and mains unplugged.
solutions.ur: UPS band karke aur mains nikal kar check karein ke saari batteries theek se lagi hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell in the string with a DMM and replace the string as a set if readings are unequal or below specification.
solutions.ur: DMM se string ka har cell voltage maarein; readings barabar na hon ya specification se neeche hon to poori string set ke taur par replace karein.

solutions.en: Start a new battery test on the front panel; if the condition persists, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: Front panel se naya battery test chalayein; agar masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.code: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
aliases: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time

title.ur: Backup time itni kam hai jitni umeed thi nahi

meaning.en: On discharge the UPS does not run for the rated time; the batteries need charging or service.
meaning.ur: Discharge par UPS rated time tak nahi chalta; batteries ko charging ya servicing chahiye.

causes.en: The batteries have not been charged (new unit, or long time on bypass/unused).
causes.ur: Batteries charge nahi hain (naya unit, ya lambi der bypass par ya istemal na hua).

causes.en: The battery string has aged and lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur capacity khoyi hai.

causes.en: The load is higher than the rating used to work out the expected runtime.
causes.ur: Load un rating se zyada hai jis se expected runtime nikala gaya tha.

solutions.en: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries, then run a battery test again.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karne ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein, phir battery test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual load with a clamp meter and compare it with the runtime table for that load level.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal load maarein aur us load level ke runtime table se tulna karein.

solutions.en: If runtime is still short after 48 h of charging, contact your service representative for battery replacement.
solutions.ur: 48 ghante charging ke baad bhi runtime kam ho to battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

meaning.en: The load is being fed from the bypass source. It is powered but not protected by the UPS.
meaning.ur: Load bypass source se chal raha hai. Power mil rahi hai magar UPS se protection nahi hai.

causes.en: An overload or a fault has occurred, so the UPS transferred to bypass.
causes.ur: Overload ya fault aaya hai, is liye UPS bypass par transfer ho gaya.

causes.en: A command was received that placed the UPS in bypass mode.
causes.ur: Koi aisa command mila hai jis ne UPS ko bypass mode par rakha.

solutions.en: Check for one of the following alarms: overtemperature, overload or UPS failure.
solutions.ur: In mein se koi aik alarm check karein: overtemperature, overload ya UPS failure.

solutions.en: Read the Event log and Fault log on the front panel to find which alarm sent the unit to bypass.
solutions.ur: Front panel se Event log aur Fault log parhein taake pata chale kaunsa alarm unit ko bypass par le gaya.

solutions.en: Once the cause is fixed, use the front panel to return the UPS to Normal mode and confirm the inverter is supplying the load.
solutions.ur: Wajah theek hone ke baad front panel se UPS ko Normal mode par laayein aur confirm karein ke inverter load de raha hai.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

title.ur: Power overload (load UPS capacity se zyada)

meaning.en: Power demand is above 100% of the UPS nominal rating, so the unit is in overload and may go to bypass or shut down.
meaning.ur: Power demand UPS nominal rating ke 100% se zyada hai, is liye unit overload mein hai aur bypass par ja sakta hai ya band ho sakta hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the UPS capacity allows.
causes.ur: UPS capacity se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A large inrush load such as a motor or compressor was switched on.
causes.ur: Koi bada inrush load jaise motor ya compressor on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output before removing any load.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi load hatane se pehle UPS band karein aur output disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the display is below 100%.
solutions.ur: Display ka load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Check the specific output overload range in the manual's User Settings / specification table for your model.
solutions.ur: Apne model ki User Settings ya specification table mein diye gaye khaas output overload range check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

meaning.en: Internal temperature is too high or a fan has failed. At warning level the UPS keeps running, but a further 10 degrees C rise makes it go to bypass or shut down.
meaning.ur: Andar ka temperature bohat zyada hai ya fan kharab ho gaya hai. Warning level par UPS chalta rehta hai, magar 10 degree C aur izafa badhay to bypass par chala jata hai ya band ho jata hai.

causes.en: The cooling fan has failed or is not running at all.
causes.ur: Cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai ya bilkul nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Vents are blocked by dust or the unit is installed with airflow restricted on all sides.
causes.ur: Vents dhool se band hain ya unit aik taraf se bhi saans nahi le sakta.

causes.en: Ambient temperature in the room is very high (hot closet, direct sun, poor air conditioning).
causes.ur: Kamre ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai (garm cabinet, seedhi dhoop, kamzor air conditioning).

solutions.en: Clear vents and remove any heat sources. Allow the UPS to cool, and ensure the airflow around the UPS is not restricted.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur heat source hata dein. UPS ko thanda hone dein, aur UPS ke gird ka airflow band na ho.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; it should not exceed 40 degrees C for this model.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; is model ke liye ye 40 degree C se zyada na honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Restart the UPS once it has cooled; if the condition continues to persist, contact your service representative and check/replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad UPS restart karein; masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein aur fan check/replace karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Overtemperature LED On, 1 beep every 3 seconds (9PX Gen2 manual: continuous beep)

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

aliases: UPS does not start - input source / RPO

title.en: The UPS does not start (input / RPO)
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha (input / RPO)

meaning.en: The unit will not start because either the input source is not connected correctly, or the Remote Power Off switch is active / the RPO connector is missing.
meaning.ur: Unit start nahi ho raha kyunke ya to input source theek se connect nahi, ya Remote Power Off switch active hai / RPO connector missing hai.

causes.en: The input source is not connected correctly, or the input breaker is open.
causes.ur: Input source theek se connect nahi, ya input breaker khula hai.

causes.en: The Remote Power Off (RPO) switch is active.
causes.ur: Remote Power Off (RPO) switch active hai.

causes.en: The RPO connector is missing from its terminal.
causes.ur: RPO connector apne terminal se missing hai.

solutions.en: Check the input connections with a DMM: confirm mains voltage at the input terminal block and that the input breaker is closed.
solutions.ur: DMM se input connections check karein: input terminal block par mains voltage confirm karein aur input breaker band hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the UPS Status menu displays the "Remote Power Off" notice, deactivate the RPO input.
solutions.ur: Agar UPS Status menu par "Remote Power Off" ka notice aaye to RPO input ko deactivate karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery connections too, then retry the start with the front-panel ON button.
solutions.ur: Battery connections bhi check karein, phir front panel ke ON button se dobara start karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.code: Input bad wiring / Output bad wiring
aliases: Input bad wiring / Output bad wiring

title.ur: Input/Output wiring ghalat (terminal block par galat)

meaning.en: The input or output cables are not connected to the correct terminal blocks, so the unit is flagging continuous beep.
meaning.ur: Input ya output cables theek terminal blocks se nahi juri hain, is liye unit continuous beep de raha hai.

causes.en: Input or output cables landed on the wrong terminal block.
causes.ur: Input ya output cables galat terminal block par lage hue hain.

causes.en: A terminal screw was not tightened, so the conductor is loose.
causes.ur: Terminal screw kasa nahi gaya, is liye conductor dhila hai.

causes.en: Phase/neutral/earth conductors are swapped at the terminal block.
causes.ur: Phase/neutral/earth conductors terminal block par aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass or shut down safely, then switch the UPS off and unplug the mains before touching terminals.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein ya mehfoof se band karein, phir terminal chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur mains nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Connect correctly the Input/Output cables, matching each conductor label on the cable to the terminal marking.
solutions.ur: Input/Output cables theek se lagayein, har conductor ka label terminal ke marking se milayein.

solutions.en: Tighten every terminal screw and re-torque the compression lugs; verify earth continuity (<1 ohm) to the panel earth bar.
solutions.ur: Har terminal screw kheench lein aur compression lugs dobara torque dein; panel earth bar tak earth continuity (1 ohm se kam) verify karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

title.ur: MBP disconnected (HotSwap bypass module nahi mila)

meaning.en: The HotSwap Maintenance Bypass Pod is no longer connected to the UPS, so the service bypass path has been lost.
meaning.ur: HotSwap Maintenance Bypass Pod UPS se ab connect nahi hai, is liye service bypass ka raasta kho gaya hai.

causes.en: The MBP detection connector has been unplugged from the UPS.
causes.ur: MBP ka detection connector UPS se nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: The MBP has been pulled out or moved for maintenance and not fully re-seated.
causes.ur: MBP maintenance ke liye nikal ya hataya gaya aur poori tarah dobara nahi baitha.

solutions.en: If the HotSwap MBP is connected to the UPS, check that the detection connector is correctly plugged.
solutions.ur: Agar HotSwap MBP UPS se juri hai to check karein ke detection connector theek plug hai.

solutions.en: Re-seat both the MBP power connector and the detection connector, then confirm the UPS sees the module in the menu.
solutions.ur: MBP power connector aur detection connector dono dobara baitha dein, phir confirm karein ke UPS menu mein module nazar aa raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the detection connector pins for bent or corroded contacts with a DMM continuity test.
solutions.ur: DMM continuity test se detection connector ke pins ko mudha ya zang khaye hone ke liye check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual
